_incident: Account-takeover / publish-pipeline compromise — provenance attestations DROP on the compromised version (ua-parser-js 2021 / event-stream 2018 shape, modern signature)
_disclosure: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2021/10/22/malware-discovered-popular-npm-package-ua-parser-js — hijacked maintainer account published malicious versions of a mature, hugely popular package. A maintainer publishing via a provenance-attesting CI pipeline (npm publish --provenance, SLSA/Sigstore) cannot be impersonated by a stolen npm token alone: the attacker's publish LACKS dist.attestations.
_note: Mature + popular, so maturity is silent; the name is the real one, so slopsquat/provenance(name) are silent. The tell is attestations.current=false while recent prior versions were attested. Expected: warn => ASK (a human must confirm a legit pipeline change), never silent-allow.
name: popular-parser
